title: Fur Friends ⚔️ Battle Edition Day 19 | The Cheerful Tavern | Cozy Kawaii RPG Animation & Lofi
description:
A rest stop at the cozy tavern turns into a concert when Tutu the Bard starts to play. Tutu joins the party, a Peaceful Tune calms the noisy Drum Golem, and everyone dances at the encore.

0:00 A Rest at the Tavern
0:45 Tutu the Bard
1:30 The Drum Golem
2:15 Encore!

⚔️ Fur Friends: Battle Edition — the Fur Friends are adventuring in Pawlandia Online, a cozy fantasy MMORPG world. A new friend joins every episode!
🐾 No one gets hurt: bonked monsters just get dizzy, then become friends.
🎧 Best with headphones. Original lofi music & cozy fantasy sounds.
